Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for the 24 mm mechanical seal were at EUR 28.94 in 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31 per piece (cost:340010).
Your quote commits to 300 ppm, while your delivered quality over the last four quarters averaged 363 ppm (sc:70410@2025Q4, sc:70410@2026Q1, sc:70410@2026Q2, sc:70410@2026Q3).

With a firm long-term commitment of this size, we propose EUR 28.94 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your historical data and cost estimates; however, our pricing is dictated by current manufacturing realities. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We meet the agreed quality targets.

We can accommodate the requested volume of 23,400 units, the 24-month contract, and the 56-day lead time. In exchange for this firm commitment, we propose a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit.

Specifically, our Angebot stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for moving. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total, which gives you planning security well beyond the 12 months you asked for in March, and propose EUR 29.79 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months and have adjusted our offer in response. However, your target price remains unfeasible given our current manufacturing realities. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
